## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of `_targets.R`'s `merged_yield_data` ->
`study2_yield_analysis_ready` steps, calling
`2_preprocessing/R/functions_yield_quality.R` directly.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_yield_quality.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Read and merge the three yearly workbooks

```{r merge}
merged_yield_data <- load_merged_yield_data(
  xlsx_2023 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2023", "HYPERFARM_YIELD_DATA_2023_v2.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2024 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2024", "HYPERFARM_VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2024_v3.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2025 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2025", "VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2025.xlsx")
)
merged_yield_data |> glimpse()
```

```{r merge-check}
merged_yield_data |> count(YEAR, PV_SETUP, PRODUCT)
```

## Step 2: Derive Study 2 modelling covariates

`add_study2_covariates()` filters to `PV_SETUP == "VERTICAL"` (Study 2's
scope -- the south-oriented setup belongs to a different comparison) and
derives `FERTILISATION`, `RESIDUE`, `CROP_PRODUCT`, `GLOBAL_SUB_STRIP_LOCATION`,
and the `ROW`/`COLUMN` spatial-structure factors used by the statistical model
factory (`3_analysis/R/functions_statistics.R`).

```{r covariates}
study2_yield_analysis_ready <- add_study2_covariates(merged_yield_data)
study2_yield_analysis_ready |> glimpse()
```

Equivalently, in one call: `build_study2_yield_dataset(xlsx_2023, xlsx_2024, xlsx_2025)`.

## Step 3: Data coverage check (EDA)

Which crop-product x year combinations actually have data, and how many
observations -- a sanity check before any modelling. New figure, following
the validated design system (sequential blue = magnitude, per
Midway (2020) Principle #4).

```{r coverage}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
plot_yield_data_coverage(study2_yield_analysis_ready)
```

`3_analysis/02_yield_and_quality_models.qmd` fits the GLMM factory to
